metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a self-contained C++20 CLI MARC 21 tool in `output/`:

- Builds with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` (run from `output/`)
- Produces `build/marc_tool` supporting:
  - `inspect` (base64 ISO 2709 → canonical JSON record)
  - `inspect_marcxml` (MARCXML → canonical JSON record)
  - `render_iso2709` (canonical JSON record → base64 ISO 2709)
  - `render_marcxml` (canonical JSON record → MARCXML)
- Validates UTF-8 payloads and MARC21 field indicator/subfield/repeatability rules extracted from `../docs/loc-bibliographic-html` at build time (embedded into the binary)
- Writes structured JSON responses and uses exit codes `0/1/2` per spec

Files added: `output/CMakeLists.txt`, `output/main.cpp`, `output/marc.cpp`, `output/marc.h`, `output/rulegen.cpp`, `output/json.cpp`, `output/json.h`, `output/xml.cpp`, `output/xml.h`, `output/utils.cpp`, `output/utils.h`.

editorial.last_message: Completed with a submitted C++ implementation (11 files, 2149 LOC), but hidden tests passed only 0/2894; the run produced scorable code with major correctness gaps.
